## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Adhikaraṇabheda* ("Various aspects of the four kinds of legal issues") is a chapter of the *Parivāra*, the fifth book of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text presents an exhaustive classification and analysis of the four types of legal questions or issues (*adhikaraṇa*): disputes, censure, offences, and obligations/duties [Horner 1966]. According to I. B. Horner, it forms the most thorough and detailed statement of the four legal issues found anywhere in the Vinaya Piṭaka, occupying its entire length without digression [Horner 1966]. In addition, the text analyses the seven procedures used for settling disciplinary matters [SuttaCentral].
SuttaCentral notes close thematic connections to the *Samathakkhandhaka* (Kd 14), the *Samathabheda* (Pvr 5), and the *Antarapeyyāla* (Pvr 4) [SuttaCentral]. Automatically computed text-reuse data from DharmaNexus confirms this distribution, identifying over 4,300 matching segments across 109 Pali texts, with the largest blocks of shared phrasing found in Pvr 4, Pvr 5, and Kd 14, as well as various *Samuccayavāra* chapters and the *Parivāra-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Cross-linguistically, DharmaNexus aligns passages with Sanskrit Vinaya and scholastic texts (such as the *Adhikaraṇavastu*, *Vinayasūtra*, and *Mahāvyutpatti*), Tibetan translations of the *Vinayavastu* and *Vinaya-uttaragrantha*, and the Chinese *Xīzhèng yīnyuán jīng* (息諍因緣經, T 85) [DharmaNexus]. Complete English translations have been published by I. B. Horner (as Chapter IX of the *Parivāra* in *The Book of the Discipline*, vol. 6) and Bhikkhu Brahmali [Horner 1966; SuttaCentral].
